title: XHR poll error
body:
I'm testing a personal data storage on a NAS for NS. All is setup, xDrip can send BGs to it, several navigators can see the NS page. The NAS side is working.

The problem is with the AAPS side. When I setup AAPS NS settings with **https://mynasdns:4443** I systematically get _xhr poll error_ 

On the NAS side, I see that the connection is on and the data seems to arrive (at least the numbers are identical).

I don't want to attach logs as I don't know what connection information will be included...

![unknown.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/188828962-7b0ca6b6-a990-49b6-b722-8f1f0f077f17.png)

![Screenshot_20220907_095638.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/188829014-6e1f3092-7ba8-4831-8151-f5055e5174b4.jpg)

Several people talk about this problem on Discord but no solution seems found for the moment.

comments.body:
Hello @robertrub,

I had the same behaviour on my initial Nightscout setup (docker). AndroidAPS tried to load all entries in the database to Nightscout and threw those errors. The Nightscout process crashed in the same time. After restarting it was running again for a while until the error came again. After some hundreds of `xhr poll error` and the corresponding re-start of the docker container the old data was uploaded finally. Since this I have never had a crash with this error again. So I haven't investigated further.

Regards
Marco
